title: Virtual Assistant - Business Operations
description:
: About Wishup Wishup is India's largest remote work platform (since 2017), connecting global businesses with top remote professionals in roles such as Virtual Assistants, Operations/Admin Managers, Executive Assistants, Project Managers, Bookkeepers, and Accountants. With a stringent 0.1% acceptance rate, each professional is upskilled and managed via our AI-based remote work tool. 
 Backed by marquee investors (Orios Ventures, Inflection Point Ventures, 500 Startups, and Tracxn Labs), Wishups leadership team includes alumni from premier institutes like IIT Madras, IIM Ahmedabad, IIT Kanpur, IIT Bombay, and DCE. 
 You have an opportunity to be part of India's first and biggest remote work platform! 
 About the role, Keynotes: Profile: Online Business Manager Role: Full-time, Long-term Contract Location: Remote - Work from home Work hours: Mon to Fri / US Shift (EST & PST) 
 What will you do? You'll be working with dynamic, growing entrepreneurs, helping them with administrative, executive, and operations tasks as mentioned below - Administrative and executive assistance - You'll help businesses and key executives with various admin and executive tasks, such as inbox and calendar management, planning itineraries, summarizing meeting minutes, creating business presentations, and more. Online research and documentation - You'll be helping clients with summarized research(primary/secondary), helping them make key business decisions. Maintaining Database and MIS Reporting - Youll be responsible for working on various databases and entrusted with data collection, data cleansing, validation, formatting, and representation of data. Lead Generation & CRM – You’ll be helping businesses find quality leads using various online platforms and web scraping methods. You’ll also help upload leads to CRM platforms, update status, and create a workflow for leads as and when required. Project Management and Coordination – You’ll coordinate with various executives, departments, and vendors for ongoing projects and events. You’ll ensure that deadlines are being met and any bumps are reported to the stakeholders promptly. Any other admin support tasks as and when assigned – You’ll help key executives in the company with any other support tasks as and when assigned. 
 What are we looking for? 2+ years of full-time professional work experience , preferably in roles involving business operations, administration, executive support, client management, or project coordination. Relevant domain experience in Healthcare, Real Estate, Venture Capital, Public Relations, Legal, E-commerce, Founder’s Office, AI/Automation, or similar business environments. Prior experience working with US or UK clients/teams is an added advantage. Stable career progression and continuity , with a consistent track record of employment and demonstrated commitment to previous roles. Excellent written and verbal communication skills , with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with clients, executives, and stakeholders. Strong ownership and accountability , with the ability to independently manage tasks, priorities, and deadlines. Strong problem-solving and logical reasoning skills , with the ability to understand business requirements and identify practical solutions. Close attention to detail and organizational skills , particularly when managing multiple tasks, stakeholders, and priorities simultaneously. Tech-savvy and adaptable , with the ability to quickly learn and work with new tools, platforms, and AI-enabled workflows. Ability to work in a fast-paced, remote environment , while remaining self-driven, organized, and responsive. 
 Job Pre-requisite Wifi - 100mbps internet speed Laptop with 16 GB RAM, Minimum i5, i3 (9th gen or newer) processor or equivalent in AMD Good camera and Headset Quiet and a well-lit workspace 
 What’s in it for you? Receive a more-than-competitive salary plus benefits Paid leave and Holidays Health coverage of up to 5 lakhs for you, your spouse, and children Performance-driven and transparent work culture Enjoy a culture with opportunities for growth and learning

title: Retail Head
description:
Role & responsibilities Lead and manage retail operations across AP & Telangana . Take ownership of sales targets, revenue growth and outlet profitability . Manage and develop Cluster Managers, Store Managers, Supervisors and retail teams . Monitor outlet-wise sales, productivity, manpower and operating costs. Drive achievement of monthly, quarterly and annual business targets. Conduct regular outlet visits and ensure adherence to company SOPs. Improve customer service, store presentation, hygiene, grooming and operational standards. Monitor inventory, stock availability, wastage, expiry and stock losses. Control manpower costs and improve employee productivity. Analyze outlet-wise performance and implement corrective action. Handle customer complaints and improve overall customer experience. Coordinate with Production, Supply Chain, HR, Finance and Marketing teams. Support new outlet openings and expansion plans across AP & Telangana. Prepare and review daily, weekly and monthly retail MIS reports. Conduct regular performance reviews with Cluster and Store Managers. Build a strong retail leadership team and succession pipeline. Ensure compliance with company policies, food safety and statutory requirements. 


 Preferred candidate profile 1015+ years of experience in Retail Operations. Proven experience handling multiple retail outlets / multi-city operations . Experience in F&B, Bakery, Sweets, QSR, FMCG or Organized Retail preferred. Strong sales and business development orientation. Strong people-management and leadership skills. Good understanding of retail P&L, inventory and cost control. Strong analytical and decision-making skills. Good knowledge of MS Excel, MIS and retail reporting . Willingness to travel extensively across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana . Should be a hands-on, field-oriented leader with strong execution capability.
